edges: Company agrees to retain all Confidential Information provided in connection with the RFP in the strictest confidence.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The Receiving Party shall not notify the Disclosing Party in case the Receiving Party is required by law, regulation, or judicial process to disclose any Confidential Information.

The Receiving Party shall not disclose the fact that the Agreement was agreed or negotiated.

Confidentiality obligations imposed on each Party shall not apply to Confidential Information to the extent that disclosure of such information is required under applicable law, regulation, or legal process.

Discussions are taking place between the parties to another person.
Receiving Party shall require those persons to sign non-disclosure restrictions
The Receiving Party cooperates with the Furnishing Party in the event the Furnishing Party elects to legally contest and avoid such disclosure.
